samples.question: The image shows one square lattice of 24 by 24 small cells inside a coloured frame. Heavier coloured rules divide the lattice into an 8 by 8 arrangement of blocks, and each block is 3 cells wide and 3 cells tall. Some small cells are filled dark. Every block contains either four or five dark cells out of its nine. Replace each block by a single square that is dark when at least five of that block's nine cells are dark and light otherwise. The 8 by 8 pattern of dark squares produced by this majority rule matches one of these symbols: plus, chevron, square, ladder, cross. Match by counting how many of the 64 squares disagree with each symbol and take the smallest count. Which symbol does it most closely match? Answer with one word.
